```{r}

basic_model = lmer(get(response_variable_selected) ~
               size * conn * dis_per +
               (1 | system_nr) +
               (1 | baseline) + 
               (1 | day),
             data = data_for_analysis,
             REML = FALSE,
             control = lmerControl(optimizer = "Nelder_Mead"))

# Extract residuals from the basic model

data_for_analysis$residuals <- resid(basic_model)

# Fit a new model with varIdent

model <- gls(residuals ~ 
               size * conn * dis_per,
             data = data_for_analysis,
             weights = varIdent(form = ~ 1 | day))

# model <-gls(bioarea_mm2_per_ml ~ size * conn * dis_per, 
#           data = data_for_analysis,
#           weights = varIdent(form =~ 1 | day * system_nr * baseline)) #Best size * dis_per * day + system_nr +
```

```{r}
# Show Q-Q plot

qqnorm(resid(model))
qqline(resid(model))

# Show Residuals vs Fitted plot

fitted_values <- fitted(model)
residuals_values <- resid(model)

plot(fitted_values, residuals_values,
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs. Fitted Values")

abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

loess_fit <- loess(residuals_values ~ fitted_values)
lines(fitted_values[order(fitted_values)],
      predict(loess_fit)[order(fitted_values)],
      col = "blue",
      lwd = 2)

#Second way of doing it
create.res.vs.fit.metaecos(model,
                           data_for_analysis)
```
